intelFeed.title: CVE-2020-29583 — Zyxel Multiple Products

intelFeed.title: CVE-2020-25213 — WordPress File Manager Plugin
intelFeed.description: WordPress File Manager Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability — WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

intelFeed.title: CVE-2021-21985 — VMware vCenter Server

intelFeed.title: CVE-2021-21972 — VMware vCenter Server

intelFeed.title: CVE-2020-3950 — VMware Multiple Products

intelFeed.title: CVE-2009-4139
intelFeed.description: A flaw was found in Spacewalk Java site packages. This cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allows a remote attacker to hijack the authentication of arbitrary users. intelFeed.title: CVE-2012-5625
intelFeed.description: OpenStack Compute (Nova) Folsom before 2012.2.2 and Grizzly, when using libvirt and LVM backed instances, does not properly clear physical volume (PV) content when reallocating for instances, which allows attackers to obtain sensitive information by reading the memory of the previous logical volume (LV).

intelFeed.title: CVE-2013-1840
intelFeed.description: A flaw was found in OpenStack Glance. Remote authenticated users can exploit this vulnerability by requesting a cached image when the single-tenant Swift or S3 store is in use. intelFeed.title: CVE-2011-1594
intelFeed.description: A flaw was found in Spacewalk, as used in Red Hat Network Satellite.
